fact: The RASS 2020 states that ESPC, general hospitals and CHR each produce a monthly activity report from their primary registers and send it to the departmental health directorate, where the district's epidemiological surveillance officer (CSE) keys all the reports received from ESPC into the DHIS2 database, while the referral hospitals' data are keyed into DHIS2 by their own data managers; national completeness of entry was 100% and promptness 98.23% in 2020.
title: Rapport Annuel sur la Situation Sanitaire (RASS) 2020
publisher: Ministère de la Santé, de l'Hygiène Publique et de la Couverture Maladie Universelle, Direction de l'Informatique et de l'Information Sanitaire (DIIS)
